listings_table.yes_id_verification_requi: Yes — ID verification required at entry
listings_table.yes_not_shown_in_public_l: Yes — not shown in public listings list
listings_table.add_attendee_parent_warni: This listing requires a child listing ({children}) when booked publicly. Adding an attendee here books it alone — add the chosen child as a separate attendee too, or the booking will be incomplete.
listings_table.listing_deactivated_warni: This listing is deactivated and cannot be booked
listings_table.creating_new_listing_base: Creating a new listing based on {name}.
listings_table.delete_warning_text: This permanently deletes the listing and its activity log entries. Its {count} attendee(s) will be unlinked from this listing rather than deleted — their attendee records and any payments are kept, and any bookings they have on other listings are unaffected.
listings_table.delete_confirmation_text: To delete this listing, type its name "{name}" into the box below:
listings_table.deactivate_effect_404: Return a 404 error on the public ticket page
listings_table.existing_attendees_not_af: Existing attendees will not be affected.
listings_table.deactivate_confirmation_t: To deactivate this listing, type its name "{name}" into the box below:
listings_table.reactivate_will_make_avai: Reactivating this listing will make it available for registrations again.
listings_table.public_page_accessible_ne: The public ticket page will be accessible and new attendees can register.
listings_table.reactivate_confirmation_t: To reactivate this listing, type its name "{name}" into the box below:
listings_table.running_totals_note: These are running totals; edit them for imports or corrections. Total attendees ever affects standard and purchase-page availability. Accuracy is not guaranteed.
listings_table.running_totals_error_expl: Expected values come from attendee rows. Got values are the stored running totals used by standard listing availability. Normal attendee changes keep these aligned; recalculate the stored totals before relying on capacity or reporting.
listings_table.running_totals_error_titl: Listing running totals do not match attendee rows.
listings_table.recalculate_choose: Choose at least one total to recalculate
listings_table.adjust_income_warning: This adds a correction to Money. It records the difference from the current income. It does not change any booking payment.
listings_table.income_ledger_recognised_: Income is what this listing earned before refunds. Profit subtracts service event costs. Net also subtracts refunds and other costs. Every change stays visible in Money.
listings_table.duration_warning_message: Changing booking duration will update existing bookings for this listing.
listings_table.recalculate_description: Compare the stored listing totals with totals counted from attendee records. Select only the stored values you want to replace.
listings_table.child_share_suppressed: This listing is offered as a child of another listing, so it has no standalone booking link, embed, or QR code — buyers choose it during the parent's booking.
listings_table.package_member_share_supp: This listing belongs to a package that hides its listings, so it has no standalone booking link, embed, or QR code — buyers book it only through the package.
listings_table.child_banner: This listing is offered as a child of {names}. It can't be booked on its own — buyers choose it while booking that listing, and it takes that listing's date and duration.
listings_table.child_field_inherited: Inherited from the parent when this listing is chosen as a child, so the settings here have no effect then.
listings_table.children_help: When this listing is booked, the buyer chooses from the ticked listings below — one for each unit they book.
listings_table.children_offered_under: This listing is itself offered under: {names}.
listings_table.children_none: No other listings to choose from yet.
listings_table.children_err_parent_renew: ''{name}'' is a renewal tier, so it can't require child listings.
listings_table.children_err_parent_is_ch: ''{name}'' is itself offered as a child of another listing, so it can't also be a parent.
listings_table.children_err_child_renewa: ''{name}'' is a renewal tier, so it can't be a child listing.
listings_table.children_err_child_is_par: ''{name}'' already has its own child listings, so it can't also be a child.
listings_table.children_err_child_addon: ''{name}'' has the opt-in add-on ''{addon}'', which only its own booking page offers — make it reachable from the parent (or remove the add-on) before offering it as a child.
listings_table.children_err_child_addon_: This change would leave the opt-in add-on {addon} reachable only through a child listing, which cannot offer it. Keep the add-on reachable (for example, by keeping the parent in its group) or remove the add-on before saving.
listings_table.children_err_child_daily: ''{name}'' is a daily listing, so it can only be a child of another daily listing — a daily add-on takes its date and length from the parent it is booked under, and only a daily listing supplies them.
listings_table.children_err_child_durati: ''{name}'' can't be booked for the same length as its parent — adjust its duration or day prices to match.

error.selected_group_deleted: The selected group was deleted. Please try again.
error.selected_listing_deleted: A selected listing was deleted. Please try again.

listings_table.group_duplicate_children_: {success}, but a cloned listing's required children weren't copied: {reason}

listings_table.listing_type_picker_impor: Upload a JSON file exported from this or another site

listings_table.template_one_off_event_de: A single in-person event on a fixed date — attendees scan in at the door
listings_table.template_weekly_event_des: A recurring event where each booking picks its own date from your available days
listings_table.template_online_digital_d: A purchase or digital ticket with no door check-in required
listings_table.template_hireable_item_de: Equipment or items for hire, dispatched and collected via logistics agents
listings_table.date_required_for_one_off: A date is required for one-off events — please enter the event date
fields.listing.name: Listing name
fields.listing.name_hint: Displayed to attendees on the ticket page
fields.listing.type_hint: Daily listings require attendees to select a specific date when booking
fields.listing.description_placeholder: A short description of the listing
fields.listing.date_hint: When the listing takes place. Times are in your configured timezone.
fields.listing.location_hint: Where the listing takes place. Shown on the ticket page.
fields.listing.max_attendees_hint: For daily listings, this limit applies per date
fields.listing.max_quantity_hint: Maximum tickets a customer can buy in one transaction
fields.listing.bookable_days_hint: Select which days of the week are available for booking
fields.listing.min_days_notice_hint: How many days in advance attendees must book (0 = same day)
fields.listing.max_days_ahead_hint: How far into the future attendees can book (0 = no limit)
fields.listing.customisable_days_hint: Let visitors choose how many days to book (1 up to the Booking duration above), each priced separately below. Works for standard and daily listings. Cannot be combined with Allow pay more.
fields.listing.customisable_days_label: Let visitors choose the number of days
fields.listing.contact_fields_hint: Which contact details to collect from attendees
fields.listing.allow_pay_more_hint: Let attendees pay more than the ticket price (the price above becomes a minimum)
fields.listing.allow_pay_more_label: Allow attendees to set their own price
fields.listing.max_price_hint: The maximum price attendees can pay. Must be at least {amount} more than the ticket price.
fields.listing.registration_closes_hint: Leave blank for no deadline. Times are in your configured timezone.
fields.listing.thank_you_url_hint: Leave blank to show a simple success message
fields.listing.webhook_url_hint: Receives POST with attendee name, email, and phone on registration
fields.listing.non_transferable_hint: Requires attendees to show ID matching the ticket name at entry
fields.listing.hidden_hint: Hide from the public listings page and search engines. The listing is still bookable via its direct link.
fields.listing.purchase_only_hint: For items people buy without being checked in, such as raffles, fundraisers, donations, merch, or digital products. Hides QR codes, check-in, and wallet passes. Shows ‘Buy now’ instead of ‘Reserve’.
fields.listing.bookable_alone_hint: Only matters when this listing is offered under one or more parents. Keeps its own booking page, catalogue entry and API eligibility so it can be sold on its own, as well as folded into its parents. Off (the default) means being a child hides its standalone page.
fields.listing.bookable_alone_label: Keep this listing's own booking page while it is offered under others
fields.listing.months_per_unit_hint: How many months one ticket buys. Leave 0 for non-renewal listings.
fields.listing.initial_site_months: Initial site months (built site listings only)
fields.listing.initial_site_months_hint: How many months the site stays active after purchase. Required when assigning a built site.
fields.listing.assign_built_site_hint: Automatically assign a built site to each ticket purchased for this listing
fields.listing.slug_hint_field: URL-friendly identifier (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores). Changing this will break any existing links, embeds, or QR codes that point to this page. Only change if you know what you're doing.
fields.listing.hidden_hint_group: Hide from the public listings page and search engines. The group is still bookable via its direct link.
fields.listing.contact_fields_hint_html: If you don't collect email addresses, attendees won't be emailed their ticket.
fields.listing.duration_days_hint: How many days each booking reserves. With Customisable days on, this is the maximum a visitor can choose. Only applies to daily listings unless Customisable days is on.
fields.validation.listing_type: Listing type must be standard or daily.
fields.validation.days_required: At least one day is required
fields.validation.duration_whole: Booking duration (days) must be a whole number.
fields.validation.duration_min: Booking duration (days) must be at least 1.
fields.validation.duration_max: Booking duration (days) must be at most {max}.
error.months_per_unit_needs_flags: Months per unit requires No check-in and Hidden listing to be enabled.
error.initial_site_months_required: Initial site months is required when a site is assigned.
error.customisable_days_with_pay_more: Customisable days cannot be combined with Allow pay more. Customisable days set a price for each day count. Allow pay more lets the visitor choose the price. Only one of them can decide what to charge. Turn one off.
